question: What's the status of the repo "meridian/web-app" for the platform team?
notes: DECLARED-BLOCKED against CHAOS-3520 (CHAOS-3490 Part 2 corpus-authoring lane, 2026-08-07). Live evidence: CHAOS-3219 Phase 2 exit run 7, world digest 2e1e254d3ee8b799fd58234e865ccf1361c2753c412d1b526bf4e79d1e445232, wave_3_1 preflight enabled=True -- receipt tests/acceptance/artifacts/wave4/scope.outcome.filtered.json recorded "scope_resolution_outcome='exact', allowed=['filtered']". 'exact' is not a near-miss: it means the scenario this case is NAMED for never occurred on the run. The expectation is NOT rewritten to 'exact' -- that would be the 'rewrite an honest expectation to force green' anti-pattern, and it would delete this case's coverage claim while reading as green. WHY IT CANNOT BE REALIZED: ScopeResolutionOutcome.FILTERED is produced only at scope_service.py:749 and :753, both requiring a non-empty `teams`, which comes from `request.team_filter_refs` (scope_service.py:711). That field is populated only by _scope_request (production_runtime.py:1125-1129) out of DevScope.team_ids -- a value the MODEL must set on a resolve_scope.v1 tool argument. Nothing anywhere parses a team name out of question text, so the phrase 'for the platform team' is inert (grep team_filter_refs across src/ finds no text-derivation site). In the acceptance stack the model cannot set it at all: the scripted provider's delegate_default heuristic offers only readiness_echo_v1 / query_metric_v1 / status_snapshot_v1 / search_evidence_v1 / data_health_v1 / list_metrics_v1 -- resolve_scope has ZERO occurrences in llm/agent/scripted_openai_service.py. Producer executed: QuestionInterpreter().interpret yields exactly one mention, [('meridian/web-app', repository)]; the team qualifier produces nothing. NO UNIQUE ASSERTION COVERAGE IS LOST BY BLOCKING: the invariants dropped here besides scope_resolution_outcome_in (resolution_path_in (which PASSED, resolution_path='deterministic-exact' -- the repo mention resolves fine; only the team-filter half is unrealizable)) are asserted by many other active cases; only this case's own named-outcome claim goes uncovered, which is exactly what CHAOS-3520 records. Retired profile entry preserved verbatim: {"expected_public_outcome": "answered_with_gaps", "expected_scope_resolution_outcome": "filtered", "resolution_path": "deterministic-exact"}. Full authored invariant list before the block is in git history for this file. [ORIGINAL NOTES, preserved verbatim: Explicit team-filter mention alongside a resolved repo entity -> ScopeResolutionService.FILTERED (scope_service.py: teams-resolved branch without org fallback). Dedicated P0-B outcome-value producer per corpus-registry-v1.md's cross-reference table; conceptually related to scope.partially-resolved-subject but a distinct code path (explicit team filter, not sub-team narrowing). [CORRECTED during Lane 2b codex round-1 remediation, 2026-08-06, from "What's the status of meridian/web-app for the platform team?": question_interpreter.py's own module docstring states plainly 'a lowercase slug ... produces no mention' -- extract_mentions requires either a capitalized _NAME token or a QUOTED span adjacent to a closed kind noun (test_question_interpreter.py's proven pattern: 'How is repo "dev-health-ops" doing?'). The original bare, unquoted lowercase slug would extract ZERO typed mentions and silently degrade to org-wide/no-subject behavior -- exactly the false-pass risk codex's wrong-kind-collision finding named, generalized here to every other case that had the same bug.]]
